title_en: Interim Measures on Registration of Arbitration Commissions

articles.content_en: These Measures are formulated in accordance with the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Arbitration Law).
The registration authority for an arbitration commission shall be the judicial administrative department of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government.

The registration authority shall, within 10 days from the date of receiving the documents specified in paragraph 3 of Article 3 of these Measures, grant establishment registration to an arbitration commission that meets the conditions for establishment and issue a registration certificate; for those that meet the conditions for establishment but the provided documents do not comply with the provisions of paragraph 3 of Article 3 of these Measures, the registration authority shall grant registration after requiring supplementation; for those that do not comply with the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 3 of these Measures, the registration authority shall not grant registration.

An arbitration commission that changes its domicile or members shall, within 10 days after such change, file a record with the registration authority and submit to the registration authority the documents related to the change.

The registration authority shall, within 10 days from the date of receiving the documents and certificates specified in paragraph 2 of Article 6 of these Measures, grant cancellation of registration to an arbitration commission that meets the conditions for termination and withdraw the registration certificate of the arbitration commission.

The registration authority's establishment registration and cancellation registration of an arbitration commission shall take effect from the date on which the registration is made, and shall be publicly announced and reported to the judicial administrative department of the State Council for archival purposes.
The registration certificate of an arbitration commission shall be printed by the judicial administrative department of the State Council.

Arbitration institutions established in municipalities directly under the Central Government and in cities that are the seats of the people's governments of provinces or autonomous regions, as well as other cities divided into districts, prior to the coming into force of the Arbitration Law, shall be reorganized in accordance with the Arbitration Law and the relevant provisions of the State Council, and shall apply for establishment registration in accordance with these Measures; those that are not reorganized shall terminate upon the expiry of one year from the date of the coming into force of the Arbitration Law.
Other arbitration institutions that were established prior to the coming into force of the Arbitration Law and do not comply with the provisions of the Arbitration Law shall terminate on the date of the coming into force of the Arbitration Law.
These Measures shall come into force as of September 1, 1995.
